entries.title: Shortcuts held with right ⌘ or right ⌃ no longer start talking
entries.body: When right ⌘ or right ⌃ is your dictation key, pressing it with another key now runs that shortcut, such as ⌘L to go back to the message box or ⌘Enter to send, and records nothing. A tap of the key, or holding it on its own, still starts talking.
entries.noPicture: The fix is a recording that no longer starts: the message box looks as it always does.
